snippet.title: Crit Happens! – The Dice Deckbuilder Roguelike | Official Teaser Trailer
snippet.description:
Take a chance and roll the dice in Crit Happens! a Dice-Building, Turn-Based Roguelike – Know when to roll and when to hold to increase your attack and defeat powerful enemies. Craft your dice and seek out magical trinkets and powerful relics that will change the way you play!

🎲 Wishlist on Steam - https://store.steampowered.com/app/3711540?utm_source=youtube_teaser
🎮 Try the demo on Itch.io - https://studio-alone.itch.io/crit-happens-demo
💬 Join the Discord - https://discord.gg/T6HgwAgn4k

Crit Happens! is a mixture of Slay the Spire and Peglin but with dice. Roll your dice to build your attack. Strategize each turn, decide which enemy to target as they move ever closer. Forge new faces onto your dice, adding special effects onto your attacks!

#IndieGame #Roguelike #DiceGame #SteamIndie #IndieDev #deckbuilding
